reasoning_traces.think:
The core operators form a layered system where rights-gated ingestion ensures integrity, paginated triage enables scalability, and distinct record states maintain semantic clarity. The universal lens unifies these into a coherent framework for large-scale source discovery. Rights-gated ingestion acts as a constraint operator enforcing compliance across all data flows, modeled as a binary condition R ≥ 1. Paginated triage introduces a combinatorial structure with O(N/P) complexity, enabling efficient processing of 500K+ URLs. Distinct record states define a categorical partitioning S(C), ensuring that each URL is classified and handled according to its access level. These primitives interact through a shared state space, where failure modes include non-compliance (R < 1), overflow (N too large without pagination), and misclassification (S ≠ C). Dualities emerge between GSI’s probabilistic inference and GSE’s deterministic state transitions, both operating on the same data graph but with different objectives. The system exhibits robustness under scaling due to modular design and explicit separation of concerns.
